item.title: NCCL Collective Communication Performance on 8x A100 SXM4 NVSwitch
item.description: Empirical benchmarking of NCCL algorithm and protocol selection on 8x A100 SXM4 NVSwitch — Ring-Tree crossover at 4-8KB, LL protocol 61% bandwidth penalty, and two undocumented performance anomalies.
